scope: Every imported route relation has a research state. Online descriptions and access statements are scoped separately from field or geometry verification. No claim of exhaustive internet coverage.

statusDefinitions.authoritative_description_found: Manager, operator or official tourism publisher describes the named route, within the stated scope. Does not establish present access or geometry.
statusDefinitions.related_authoritative_source_found: A primary source concerns the place, section, historical restriction or candidate identity. Exact route equivalence is not established.
statusDefinitions.publisher_description_found: Primary trail publisher describes its route; land-manager authority and current access are not established.
statusDefinitions.related_publisher_source_found: Publisher page describes a wider or related itinerary; exact imported relation is not established.
statusDefinitions.project_reference_found: Project/network exists according to its own publisher; the relation is not a single approved trip.
statusDefinitions.secondary_source_only: Only a secondary description was reviewed.
statusDefinitions.no_authoritative_confirmation_found: A bounded website/search attempt was made; authoritative confirmation was not established. This is not evidence the route does not exist.
statusDefinitions.unnamed_identity_unresolved: No usable route name in imported data; no invented identity.
statusDefinitions.reference_identity_not_researched: Only a route number/code; not yet linked to an authoritative identity.
